script: Tiny white ant eggs are carefully tended by worker ants within the hidden depths of the dark underground nest. Hatching from these fragile eggs emerge legless larvae that rely entirely on adults for constant nourishment and care. During the resting pupal stage, the motionless insect undergoes a remarkable internal transformation into an adult form. Newly emerged adult workers begin their lives inside the subterranean nest by performing essential maintenance and nursery duties. As these workers grow older, they transition to foraging outside for vital resources to sustain the entire growing colony. Within the heart of the community, the specialized queen remains focused primarily on continuous egg production and colony expansion. Mature colonies eventually produce winged reproductives that prepare to leave the natal nest during seasonal mating flights. Successful mated females shed their wings to establish brand new foundations and begin the intricate cycle anew.
